question: How can I plan my trip improvements?

sections.beforeHtml: Use trip improvements when you want to keep a clear list of changes that can make your trip better. This feature is designed first of all for AI trip improvement suggestions, where Plantour generates the list for you automatically. You can also fill and edit this list manually. Make sure you have a current trip selected, then go to the trip improvements list.
items: Review the current list and read the suggestions in order.
Use Add when you want to create a new improvement manually.
On the form, write a short title that explains the idea clearly.
In the details field, describe what should be done and what to check next.
Set the order number so the most important improvement appears first.
Save the row and return to the list to continue planning.
Mark improvements as accepted or rejected after you review them.
If you want Plantour to suggest ideas for you, open Generate with AI from the list menu and review the generated improvements before acting on them.
sections.afterHtml: The list page and the add or edit form both work with the same planning flow: write the improvement, decide its priority, save it, and then track your decision from the list.
